text: 上海钢联钨行业分析师吕彦楠表示，钨价上涨最核心的驱动因素是供给刚性约束叠加需求释放造成的供需错配，价格自矿端持续上行。面对全球“抢钨”热潮，中国优势依然稳固。中金公司7月29日发布的研报显示，中国国内APT、钨粉加工费均值较2025年分别上涨331%、447%，出口结构向高附加值转移，海外溢价创历史新高。 （中新经纬）
text_en: Lyu Yannan, a tungsten industry analyst at Shanghai Metals Market, said that the core driver of the tungsten price increase is the supply-demand mismatch caused by rigid supply constraints combined with released demand, with prices continuing to rise from the mining end. In the face of the global "tungsten rush," China's advantage remains solid. A research report released by CICC on July 29 shows that the average processing fees for domestic APT and tungsten powder in China rose by 331% and 447% respectively compared with 2025, the export structure shifted toward higher value-added products, and overseas premiums hit a record high. (China News Service)
